text: What if you did Y raises every day for thirty days?
Day one. Two kilos feels heavy. Your lower traps are barely awake.
Day seven. You can finally feel them working.
Day fourteen. Shoulders sit back, your chest opens, and deep breaths come easier.
Day thirty. Overhead press up about eight percent, and a little more upper back.
Then change the tool. Bench, to learn strict form. Dumbbells bent over, hardest at the top. Cables, loaded from the very first inch.
